question: Can a compact frozen vision-language model explicitly separate door-level entrances, no-entrance scenes, and large doorless entry mouths, then retain the correct door region in a fixed Top-3 grid without semantic-threshold tuning?

representation.name: Typed VLM Portal Grid
representation.single_change: Replace failed closed-set door pixels with two frozen Qwen2-VL forced-choice heads: a three-state entrance-topology decision and a fixed 3x3 door-center localization distribution.
representation.why_different: The source is joint scene-language topology with explicit NONE and large-open-mouth states, not a door-class score, connected-component threshold, open-vocabulary object prompt, handle heuristic, appearance matcher, or geometry-proposal rescue.
representation.authority_separation: TVPG never receives the requested entity name or OCR text. Frozen SCIL supplies entity identity separately; TVPG supplies only a generic door-level state and coarse grid region.

model.training_role: Generic pretrained vision-language instruction model; no PB1-PB8 image, entity, portal truth, or navigation supervision.

prompts.typed_scene: Classify only the entrance topology visible in this image. Reply with exactly one digit: 1 if a pedestrian-scale doorway is visible and at least one door leaf, jamb, or door frame defines it, including open automatic glass doors; 2 if no building entrance is visible; 3 if the visible entry is a station-, market-, campus-, or atrium-scale open mouth without a door-level boundary. Ignore signs and entity identity. Answer:
prompts.grid_localization: Divide the image into a 3 by 3 grid numbered 1 through 9 from left to right, top to bottom. Locate the center of the clearest pedestrian-scale doorway defined by a visible door leaf, jamb, or door frame. Reply with exactly one digit for its cell. Ignore signs, text, large doorless station or market mouths, and unrelated interior doors. Answer:

forced_choice_rule.localization_labels: Digits 1-9 represent a fixed 3x3 grid in reading order.
forced_choice_rule.decision: For each head, select the largest next-token logit among only the declared single-token labels. No generated text, threshold, calibration, retry, crop, chain of thought, or prompt ensemble.
forced_choice_rule.top3: Rank the nine fixed grid cells by localization label log probability and retain three. Attach source identity only when the scene label is 1 and PB7 SCIL proved the exact source entity.

development_cohort.authority: The eight PB7 images are consumed Development data after the frozen BD-DCF confirmation failed.
development_cohort.identity: Reuse the already sealed PB7 SCIL result: 8/8 correct proofs, zero wrong proofs, zero UNKNOWN. OCR is not rerun.

runtime.backend: CUDA-only after verified availability; fail closed on actual CPU fallback.

stop_rule: Run exactly once. Do not change prompts, definitions, image pixels, resolution, labels, logit rule, grid, Top-3, model, precision, role truth, human boxes, or gate after output. A pass earns one new entity-disjoint confirmation; a failure closes this direct typed-VLM representation without prompt or model sweeps.
next_step: If the Development gate passes, freeze the exact TVPG representation and run one new entity-disjoint same-frame SCIL plus TVPG confirmation. If it fails, change the information modality rather than tune prompts or logits on this cohort.
claim_boundary: Development-only evidence on the consumed PB7 cohort. A Top-3 grid cell is a coarse current-frame portal region, not a precise door-leaf mask. A pass would not prove fresh generalization, natural prevalence, physical portal ownership, public access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, directional guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
